title: Freeze all actual local and remote refs without losing work

role: Coordinator + repository-analysis agents

Capture status, untracked paths, worktrees, remotes, current HEAD, local heads, tracking refs and upstreams before fetching. Preserve all uncommitted work; do not stash, clean, reset or delete on the operator's behalf.

With read access, fetch all configured remotes without pruning or force-updating existing user refs. Compare advertised remote heads to the 79 pinned refs. Record stale, moved, added, absent and inaccessible refs, including real local-only branches.

Run the supplied collector into a new external evidence directory. The collector itself does not fetch. For protected/non-fast-forward tracking refs, preserve old IDs and use separate audit refs rather than overwriting them.

Recheck repository ruleset 14746904 and current PR/check policy through read APIs. Confirm remote writes remain disabled. Expand inventory/dossiers for newly discovered sources; do not silently remove a disappeared branch.
Ask an independent inventory reviewer to reconcile advertised heads, local refs and the snapshot. Block implementation until the real local coverage and missing-object issues are resolved.

Any movement from the planning snapshot invalidates affected decisions and test evidence before implementation.
